answer: Picture a glacier of simultaneous, deadline-bound challenges: each epoch every identity must solve its own fresh task within seconds. An operator piloting many masks shares one inference pipeline, so their combined throughput melts, and the latency signal exposes serialized stalling no honest solo agent shows. Each answer is sealed with a per-identity quill, a keyed commitment, so one brain cannot cheaply sign for a crowd. Faking a thousand sybils then demands a thousand real parallel workers, not one.
